what_it_is.prose: The ideaForge Switch UAV is a Vertical Take-Off and Landing (VTOL) fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle family manufactured by ideaForge Limited (BSE: 544048), India's largest drone manufacturer. The Switch family comprises three variants — Switch Mini, Switch UAV, and Switch MAX — with endurance ranging from 1 to 7 hours and range from 5 to 50 km depending on variant. The operational altitude is 4,500 m (14,700 ft), making the Switch suitable for high-altitude deployments including Eastern Ladakh. The payload is an EO/IR gimbal for day/night surveillance. ideaForge's Switch UAVs have been delivered to the Indian Army, Border Security Force (BSF), Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF), Indian Navy, and Indian Air Force. The Switch was combat-proven during the 2020 Eastern Ladakh standoff with China, where it was deployed for surveillance along the Line of Actual Control. ideaForge listed on BSE in July 2023 (code 544048) and has a strong order book from Indian security forces. The company is headquartered in Mumbai and was founded in 2004 by IIT Bombay alumni.

faq.question: What is the difference between Switch Mini, Switch UAV, and Switch MAX?
faq.answer: The ideaForge Switch family comprises three VTOL fixed-wing variants. Switch Mini is the smallest, with shorter endurance (~1 hour) and range (~5 km), suited for short-range tactical surveillance. Switch UAV is the standard variant with longer endurance (~2-3 hours) and range (~10-15 km). Switch MAX is the largest, with the longest endurance (~7 hours) and range (~50 km) for extended surveillance missions. All three share the VTOL fixed-wing design that allows vertical takeoff/landing without a runway and efficient fixed-wing cruise flight.

faq.question: Was the Switch UAV used in Eastern Ladakh?
faq.answer: Yes. The ideaForge Switch UAV was combat-proven during the 2020 Eastern Ladakh standoff with China, where it was deployed for surveillance along the Line of Actual Control. The Switch's 4,500 m (14,700 ft) operational altitude made it suitable for high-altitude deployments in Eastern Ladakh, where conventional quadcopters struggle with thin air. The Switch was used to monitor Chinese troop movements and provide real-time situational awareness to Indian Army commanders.

faq.question: Is ideaForge listed on the stock exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. ideaForge Limited listed on BSE (code 544048) in July 2023 via an IPO that was oversubscribed 51 times — among the most oversubscribed Indian defence IPOs. The company is headquartered in Mumbai and was founded in 2004 by IIT Bombay alumni. ideaForge is India's largest drone manufacturer by market share and has a strong order book from Indian security forces.
